analysis: All four units are documentation-only. docs/developer/build.md (head lines 447-1248) covers toolchain pins, MLX submodule gitlinks, metallib build guidance, App Attest release qualification steps, advisory review tooling and migration maintenance. docs/developer/test.md (hunk @@ -3506) adds a paragraph on landing/tests/story-gestures.test.mjs, a DOM-only gesture test for the landing page. A second test.md unit (67373c0eff1153bd:0) carried only metadata and no content. No executable source, authorization logic, attestation checks, encryption, billing or protocol behavior changes. The changes do not invalidate the T-041, TB-011 or T-053 assumptions. The build.md text keeps existing statements: signed-artifact qualification is separate from default-off worker staging, diagnostics and fault flags are not forwarded to the LaunchAgent, and runtime smoke markers are required. The doc also states that the threat-model review tool never executes PR code and that paid scanning defaults to disabled. Nothing here weakens those claims, though I could not verify them against workflow code. I flagged no new attack surface. Later passes should examine whether any non-doc files in this PR (not supplied here) touch the landing story-gestures source or the CI workflows referenced by the docs. This batch gave no evidence on those. No threat-model updates are needed from these units.
